scope: Refresh broad DWG/DXF peer research around release freshness, version- and direction-specific writer limits, 3DSOLID/REGION omission reporting, ACIS carrier versus B-rep capability, and existing local regression ownership.

method.kind: Primary-source review of peer releases, project documentation, issue/PR status, and local regression owners
localInspection: tests/dwg_local_roundtrip_tests.cpp: generated AC1027 nested solid-only block, shared/nested INSERT, ACDSDATA key and marker-payload transport controls
tests/dxf_fixture_tests.cpp: unsupported-entity omission-count and transactional destination-publication control
DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: PAR-07 and existing S2/S3/S8 peer, carrier, writer-loss, and consumer gates
method.evidenceRule: Peer issue reports are scoped to their stated artifact and route; open PR branches do not establish released behavior. Entity census, exit status, or carrier presence does not establish body semantics. A downstream consumer of a parser, or two tools sharing source/expected-value lineage, is not counted as independent semantic evidence.

evidence.topic: LibreDWG peer freshness does not erase its direction and version asymmetry
evidence.observed: The release page showed 0.14.8612 with commit prefix f860b0f as the newest visible pre-release, dated 2026-10-13. The current project README states DWG writing works only through R2004 and dxf2dwg targets R2000; it separately notes that release builds exclude unstable objects/features. Issue #1411 remained open and is scoped to LibreDWG 0.14.8593 / 8a1ae764.
doesNotEstablish: that issue #1411 remains present or is fixed in 0.14.8612
modern DWG writer parity from broad DWG reader or DWG-to-DXF coverage
ACDS/SAB carrier or B-rep semantics for any untested build
evidence.planUse: At the scheduled optional peer gate, pin the exact artifact and build profile and separate DWG read, DXF write, DWG rewrite, version conversion, and modern AcDs/SAB behavior by direction and version.

evidence.topic: ACadSharp reports a concrete writer-loss profile but its corrective route is unmerged and ACDS refactor has a reported branch failure
evidence.observed: Issue #1195 reports 3DSOLID/REGION omission by the 3.4.9 DXF writer for private customer drawings, including blocks made empty when their only contents are modeler entities. It says LibreDWG was used to cross-check entity census, which is not independent semantic evidence. The issue says no notification was observed, while a maintainer reply notes a notification path for unimplemented entities; actual behavior requires a pinned execution. Writer PR #1240 remained open and depends on ACDS schema refactor PR #1174. A reviewer on #1174 reported a failing ACDS owner-attachment test on that branch due to NotImplementedException and reported R2013+ payload loss there.
doesNotEstablish: a defect in current released ACadSharp versions beyond the reported 3.4.9 route
the notification behavior on a current release
format semantics or libdxfrw behavior from a private drawing report
released ACIS writer capability from open PR code
evidence.planUse: Keep the route non-qualifying until a released immutable artifact and full dependency graph are pinned and executed. If used, compare per-entity diagnostics, block/INSERT closure, carrier/key bytes, and strict readback; do not count the LibreDWG census as a second independent witness.

evidence.topic: ezdxf supports bounded ACIS carrier and polyhedral operations but does not supply a solid kernel or 3D renderer
evidence.observed: The ACIS guide states that ezdxf has no ACIS kernel, targets extraction of flat polygonal faces, and loses curved-boundary faces in mesh_from_body(). It documents polyhedral SAT authoring for DXF R2000-R2010 and SAB authoring for R2013-R2018. The drawing add-on documentation says it does not render ACIS and projects 3D entities into XY.
doesNotEstablish: general ACIS dialect coverage or arbitrary B-rep validity
native CAD application acceptance from a parser or 2D renderer
evidence.planUse: Keep ezdxf as an optional exact-pinned DXF/carrier inspector and scratch polyhedral control only. Preserve separate result columns for bytes, parsed topology, mesh projection, and native/kernel acceptance.

evidence.topic: Local tests already cover generated solid-only block carrier transport and generic writer omission reporting
evidence.observed: The existing modeler block projection control constructs a nested/shared block graph whose inner block contains only a modeler entity, tests ASCII and binary AC1027 DXF, and checks ACDSDATA key-to-owner and marker bytes. The payload is deliberately not valid SAB, so the test proves transport/association rather than solid semantics. Existing DXF omission tests check type/count diagnostics and transactional destination preservation.
doesNotEstablish: valid modeler payload interpretation or B-rep semantics
every unsupported 3D entity and target-version writer diagnostic
evidence.planUse: Reuse the existing test owners. Add a narrow generated negative or diagnostic case only if a changed 3D writer/version path is not covered; do not add external drawing fixtures or duplicate generic tests.
